In the second trimester, PUV represent the most common cause of lower urinary tract obstruction in boys, affecting 1 in 4,000–8,000 infants. In utero, PUV should be suspected in the following situations: failure of the bladder to empty, presence of abnormal kidneys and oligohydramnios.
